sammendrag: Training  Most support goes to non-employed individuals  Have had customized job training for employed individuals for attraction/expansion purposes  Now using training for incumbent workers for retention/competitiveness purposes  Total OJT ≈ $50-$60 billion; subsidized training ≈ $600-$800 million (about 1%)
